document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const WPM = 183;
    const contentElementReadingTime = document.querySelector(".reading_time_count_content");
    const readingTimeContainers = document.querySelectorAll(".reading-time-custom");

    if (contentElementReadingTime && readingTimeContainers.length > 0) {
        const textContent = contentElementReadingTime.innerText || contentElementReadingTime.textContent;
        const wordCount = textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
        const readingTimeMinutes = Math.ceil(wordCount / WPM);

        const readingTimeText = ` | Reading Time: ${readingTimeMinutes} minute${readingTimeMinutes > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;

        readingTimeContainers.forEach(container => {
            container.textContent = readingTimeText;
        });
    }
});

</script>
